tools.name: getVaults
tools.title: Get Vaults
tools.description: Get a list of all available Obsidian vaults with their names and paths
tools.instructions: Use this tool when you need to know what Obsidian vaults are available. This is useful before using other tools that require a vault name. Call this proactively if the user's request involves vaults but doesn't specify which one.

tools.name: searchNote
tools.title: Search Note
tools.description: Search for notes in Obsidian vaults by title, path, and optionally content.
tools.instructions: Use this tool to find notes. By default searches title and path only (searchContent=false). Set searchContent=true only when the user needs full-text or tag search ('tag:tagname'). Content search skips Markdown files larger than 1 MiB to stay under the extension memory limit. Returns a list of matching notes with vault name and path. Does not open Obsidian. Specifying a vault name is very important. Only keep it empty when the user did not mention anything in that direction.

tools.name: createNote
tools.title: Create Note
tools.description: Create a new note in an Obsidian vault.
tools.instructions: Use this tool to create new notes. For regular notes: supports tags, custom paths within vaults, and templates. If you need to know available vaults, use getVaults first.

tools.name: openNote
tools.title: Open Note
tools.description: Open a note in Obsidian application
tools.instructions: Use this tool ONLY when the user EXPLICITLY wants you to open a note in Obsidian. Do NOT use it in any other case.

tools.name: appendNote
tools.title: Append to Note
tools.description: Append or prepend content to an existing note or today's daily note
tools.instructions: Use this tool to add content to existing notes or daily notes. For regular notes: provide notePath. For daily notes: set useDailyNote to true (requires Advanced URI plugin). Supports prepending, headings, and template expansion. Silent mode available for daily notes. If you need to know available vaults, use getVaults first.

tools.name: readNote
tools.title: Read Note
tools.description: Read the full content of a specific note by its full path
tools.instructions: Use this tool to read the complete content of a note when you have the exact path. Use this after searchNote to get the full content of a specific note.

tools.name: updateNote
tools.title: Update Note
tools.description: Update a note by replacing specific content with new content
tools.instructions: Use this tool to edit existing note content by replacing specific sections. Provide the exact text to find (oldContent) and what to replace it with (newContent). The oldContent must exactly match the text in the note. Does not open Obsidian.
